decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis app is a flagship product line closely tied to the core practice software, and demand for practice digitalization keeps rising.
The continuing education institute builds on the firm's training expertise and strengthens customer loyalty at low cost.
Remote screen-sharing support is an essential, low-cost part of efficient customer service, especially after the pandemic.
The analytics dashboard adds value to the core software and fits the firm's push toward efficiently managed practices.
The complete practice bundle packages existing offerings for new practices, so it costs little to maintain and supports sales.
The job and practice listing portal is distant from the core business and faces competition, but it is cheap to run and keeps the firm in contact with practices.
